why: The final main-sequence rerun, leg 3: the 28 4D stars still burning after evolve4-26b (each resumes its -tv2 checkpoint), and ours' seven OPAL tracks started fresh at khmin=0.1 under tag v2k (leg 1 ran them at the default KHMIN, where six stalled at zero age; commit 2fe72f982). Fifteen 4D stars finished in leg 2; six stopped on the solver and are held back for diagnosis.
